trivia.q: In “Gay Witch Hunt”, why does Andy start calling Jim “Big Tuna” in Stamford?

cite.t: I ate a tuna sandwich, on my first day. So, Andy started calling me Big Tuna. ...I don't think any of them actually know my real name.

trivia.why: Nobody is allowed to look at their own card, and everyone is told to treat each other like the race on it.

cite.t: I have something here. I want you to take a card. Put it on your fore... Don't look at the card. I want you to take the card and put it on your forehead and... Take a card, take a card, any card. Um... And I want you to treat other people like the race that is on their forehead. OK? So everybody has a different race. Nobody knows what their race is, so... I want you to really go for it, cause this is real. You know, this isn't just an exercise. This is real life. And... I have a dream that you will really let the sparks fly. Get 'er done.

trivia.q: In “Health Care”, who ends up in charge of picking the office’s new health care plan?
trivia.why: Jim turns Michael down and suggests Dwight, who slashes benefits to the bone and claims the conference room as his office.

cite.t: That's not entirely true, because he put me in charge of picking the health care plan.

trivia.q: In “Health Care”, one of the fake diseases turned in on Dwight’s anonymous survey is named after a breakfast cereal. Which one?
trivia.why: Dwight reads out “Count Choculitis” and accuses Jim of writing it because he knows Dwight loves the cereal.

cite.t: Why did you write that down Jim? Is it because you know I love Count Chocula?

trivia.q: In “The Alliance”, how does Dwight spy on the rumoured warehouse meeting during Meredith’s birthday party?
trivia.why: Dwight agrees to poke air holes in it, and Jim sends Pam downstairs to find him on the floor near the shelves.

cite.t: Pam, he's in a box. He's downstairs, in a box, on the floor, near the shelves. I'm serious. Go down there and work your magic.

trivia.q: In “The Alliance”, what did Michael not realize about his $25 pledge to Oscar’s nephew’s walk-a-thon?
trivia.why: Oscar points out that the sheet says dollars per mile and that his nephew walked 18 miles last year.

cite.t: I just thought it was kind of a flat, you know... 25 dollar, one-time donation. I didn't think it was per mile kinda deal. You know, so...

trivia.q: In “Basketball”, which of Pam’s appliances has broken, three years after she got it at her engagement shower?
trivia.why: Jim notes that the wedding it was a gift for still has no date, three years later.

cite.t: Pam gets a little down. Her toaster oven broke. Um, which she got at her engagement shower. Um, for a wedding that still has yet to be set... and that was three years ago.

trivia.q: In “Hot Girl”, what is Katy selling when Michael lets her set up in the office?
trivia.why: Roy calls her “that little purse girl”, and Jim tells Dwight that buying a purse is his fallback if his chat with her stalls.

cite.t: Hey, Jimmy what do you think of that little purse girl, huh?

trivia.q: In “Hot Girl”, what does Michael buy as the $1,000 top-seller prize, then use himself to impress Katy?
trivia.why: Stanley notices Michael serving Katy espresso from the machine that was supposed to go to the top salesperson.

cite.t: Yes. This is a Starbucks digital barista. This is the mack daddy of espresso makers.

trivia.q: In “The Dundies”, which restaurant hosts the awards night?
trivia.why: A few drinks in, Pam tells the crowd she feels God in this Chili’s tonight, and the restaurant later bans her for sneaking drinks.

cite.t: And, I feel God in this Chili's tonight. WHOOOOOOOO!!!!

trivia.q: In “Sexual Harassment”, who does Michael assign to drive Todd Packer around because of Packer’s DUI?
trivia.why: Packer later complains that the two of them got lost for half an hour.

cite.t: Oh. Bad boy. Um... Ryan?

trivia.q: In “Office Olympics”, what is Michael out of the office signing papers for?
trivia.why: Dwight tags along and points out that a 30-year mortgage means Michael will be paying it off in his mid-seventies.

cite.t: Well, this isn't about work. This is closing on a condo, it's completely personal.

trivia.q: In “Office Olympics”, Kevin and Oscar’s paper football game is named after which co-worker’s dislike of it?
trivia.why: Kevin explains the name, Hate Ball, and Jim takes a flick at it himself before the Olympics get going.

cite.t: Because of how much Angela hates it.

trivia.q: In “The Fire”, what starts the fire that empties the office into the parking lot?
trivia.why: Dwight announces that the business-school temp left it on the oven setting instead of the toaster setting.

cite.t: Everyone, okay? Uh, I have an announcement. Apparently, in business school, they don't teach you how to operate a toaster oven. Because some smart, sexy temp left his cheese pita on oven instead of timing it for the toaster thing.

trivia.q: In “The Fire”, Dwight first says he would bring an axe instead of books to a desert island. Which book does he settle on?
trivia.why: Jim tells him it has to be a book, and Dwight adds that his copy would be hollowed out inside.

cite.t: Fine. Physician's Desk Reference.

trivia.q: In “Halloween”, who does Michael finally fire after Creed talks his way out of it?
trivia.why: Creed tells Michael that Devon is terrible and he should fire him instead, and Michael goes along with it.

cite.t: That's why I'm being fired?

trivia.q: In “The Fight”, where do Michael and Dwight finally square off?
trivia.why: Michael extends lunch by an hour so the whole office can go watch.

cite.t: Um, well, we are all getting excited to see this fight. The Albany branch is working right through lunch to prevent downsizing, but Michael, he decided to extend our lunch by an hour so we could all go down to the dojo and watch him fight Dwight. Fight... Fight, fight, fight, fight, fight, fight, I'm coming, fight...

trivia.q: In “The Fight”, who does Michael list as his own emergency contact?
trivia.why: Dwight, sore after losing the fight, changes his own emergency contact from Michael to “The Hospital.”

cite.t: My emergency contact is Todd Packer. Todd F. Packer. Do you know what the F. stands for?

trivia.q: In “The Client”, the staff hold a reading of Michael’s screenplay. Who plays the villain Goldenface?
trivia.why: Jim, reading the narration, casts Oscar on the spot, and Goldenface invites Agent Michael Scarn onto his private jet.

cite.t: A man sitting several seats down, who has a gold face, turns to Michael Scarn. Uh... Ooh, Oscar, you wanna play Goldenface?

trivia.q: In “Performance Review”, what day does Jim convince Dwight it is?
trivia.why: It is really Thursday, and Pam and Jim back it up by chatting about last night’s episode of The Apprentice, which Jim says is on every Thursday.

cite.t: Today is Thursday. But Dwight thinks that it's Friday. And that's what I'll be working on this afternoon.

trivia.q: In “E-Mail Surveillance”, what does Michael learn he has not been invited to by reading staff e-mail?
trivia.why: The e-vite guest list has nearly the whole office on it, and Jim admits he left Michael off so people could relax.

cite.t: Meredith has an E-vite from Jim. Barbeque at Jim's tonight. Tonight? Wonder where my e-vitation is. Click on guest list. Angela, Stanley, Oscar, Meredith, Phyllis, Kevin, Creed. Must be... . No.

trivia.q: In “Christmas Party”, what Secret Santa gift does Jim buy for Pam?
trivia.why: He stuffs it with inside jokes, including his high school yearbook photo and a hot sauce packet, plus a card.

cite.t: So this year, for the first time ever, I got Pam in Secret Santa. And I got her this teapot, which I know she really wants, so she can make tea at her desk. But I'm also going to stuff it with some inside jokes. Like, this is my high school yearbook photo. She saw it at the party, and it really makes her laugh. Not sure why. What else .. ooh. This is a hot sauce packet. She put this on a hot dog a couple years ago because she thought it was ketchup. And it was really funny, so I kept the other two. This would take a little too long to explain, so I won't. And this is the card. Because Christmas is the time to tell people how you feel.

trivia.q: In “Christmas Party”, what does Michael bring back from the liquor store to liven up the party?
trivia.why: He asks the clerk if it is enough to get 20 people plastered, even though Pam warned him they cannot serve liquor.

cite.t: Fifteen bottles of vodka? Yeah, that should do it.

trivia.q: In “Booze Cruise”, what does Michael announce to everyone on board as a “business scenario”?
trivia.a: That the boat is about to sink
w: That the boat is out of fuel
That Corporate is closing the branch
trivia.why: Someone jumps overboard in the panic, and Michael ends up locked in the boat’s brig.

cite.t: Vomicillin. Okay. All right. It's time to be boss. It's time to motivate. Let's blow some minds here. Okay, guys, guys, cool it. Everybody, Dunder-Mifflin Scranton employees, Brenda, I have some very, very urgent news I need to tell everybody right now. Listen up. The ship is sinking! Okay? We're going down, right now. Just wrap your heads around the reality of that. Shh, please! Everybody, it's my turn now, okay? Captain Jack is gone. In five minutes, this ship is going to be at the bottom of the lake! And there aren't enough spaces on the lifeboat! Who are we gonna save? Do we save sales? Do we save customer service? Do we save accounting? This is a business scenario. Right? It's a scary... it's a...

trivia.q: In “Booze Cruise”, Roy stands up and finally sets a date for his wedding to Pam. Which date does he pick?
trivia.why: Roy credits Captain Jack’s talk about what really matters, and the captain offers to marry them on the spot.

cite.t: Hello, everybody, could I have your attention for just a second? Could you listen to me for a second? We were up at the front, and we were talking about what's really important, and... Pam, I think enough is enough. I think we should set a date for our wedding. How about June 10th? Come on, let's do it! Come on, Pam!

trivia.q: In “The Injury”, what does Michael burn his foot on?
trivia.why: He lays six strips of bacon on it before bed so he can wake up to the smell, and this morning he stepped onto it and it clamped down on his foot.

cite.t: OK, buhhhh, I burned my foot very badly on my Foreman Grill and I now need someone to come and bring me into work.

trivia.q: In “The Injury”, Dwight crashes his car into a pole while rushing to rescue Michael. What injury does he end up with?
trivia.why: Billy Merchant is the one who spots it, describing Dwight as “the moon-faced kid who crashed into the pole.”

cite.t: No, not Michael. The moon-faced kid who crashed into the pole. He looks like he has a concussion.

trivia.q: In “The Secret”, what secret of Jim’s does Michael struggle to keep?
w: That he is back with Katy
That he lied about being sick
trivia.why: Jim told him on the booze cruise, and before long Kelly is asking Jim why he never told her.

cite.t: Yeah. On the booze cruise I told Michael about some feelings I used to have for Pam. I had just broken up with Katy and had a couple drinks. And I confided in the world's worst confidant.

trivia.q: In “The Secret”, Dwight stakes out Oscar’s place after Oscar calls in sick. Along with shopping bags, what does Dwight spot that proves Oscar was not sick?
trivia.why: Oscar is with a man named Gil, and he asks Dwight whether he is going to tell Michael.

cite.t: Stay low... This is it... There he is. He's been gone for at least two hours. Who is that? Come to Papa... Oh yes. Let's roll. I knew it! You are so busted. Ice skates, shopping bags? I think I know what's going on here. You weren't sick at all.

trivia.q: In “The Carpet”, who turns out to be behind the mess left on Michael’s office carpet?
trivia.why: Packer calls to ask whether Michael got the “package” he left in the middle of his office, and Michael finds it hilarious.

cite.t: That was Packer! Oh, you're... you are dead. You are dead, my friend! That is hilar... Oh, God! Of course it was you.

trivia.q: In “Boys and Girls”, what does Jan tell Pam the company offers in New York?
trivia.why: By the end of the day Pam backs out, saying Roy is right that there is no guarantee it would lead to anything.

cite.t: You know the company is offering a design training program in New York.

trivia.q: In “Valentine’s Day”, who keeps sending Phyllis gifts at the office?
trivia.why: One card is signed “Bob Vance, Vance Refrigeration”, and Pam spends the day watching Phyllis get an entire garden delivered.

cite.t: "Happy Valentine's Day darling. Love Bob Vance, Vance Refrigeration."

trivia.q: In “Valentine’s Day”, what gift does Dwight find waiting on his desk?
trivia.why: Jim says it was there when he sat down, and Dwight later thanks Angela for the best present he has ever gotten while she plays dumb.

cite.t: Happy Valentine's Day. It's me. I'm the bobble head. Yes! Ahh!

trivia.q: In “Dwight’s Speech”, whose speech does Jim slip Dwight for his Salesman of the Year address?
trivia.why: Jim also coaches him that great speakers wave their arms and pound their fists.

cite.t: Ok, I didn't actually major in Public Speaking. But, I did download speeches from some of history's famous dictators. Like this one. Originally given by Benito Mussolini.

trivia.q: In “Dwight’s Speech”, Jim asks the office for trip ideas. Where does Toby say he went after his divorce?
trivia.why: Toby cannot remember if he stayed a week or a month, and Creed warns Jim that he does not want to go there.

cite.t: Been to Amsterdam.

trivia.q: In “Take Your Daughter to Work Day”, which children’s TV show does Michael say he starred in as a kid?
trivia.why: He sends Ryan to his mother’s house in Dickson City to dig the tape out of the basement.

cite.t: I am totally serious. There was a show called 'Fundle Bundle' and I was the star.

trivia.q: In “Michael’s Birthday”, what test result is Kevin anxiously waiting on all day?
trivia.why: Angela tells Michael no one cares about his birthday, and when the result comes back negative, Michael at first takes it as bad news.

cite.t: Um, I might have skin cancer.

trivia.q: In “Michael’s Birthday”, who does Michael bump into at the skating rink?
trivia.why: She is there for her daughter’s skating lesson, and Michael gives her two kids a ride around the ice.

cite.t: Yeah. Carol? She sold me my condo! Hey! What, is this place on the market? Or...

trivia.q: In “Drug Testing”, what does Dwight find in the parking lot that sets off his investigation?
trivia.why: Dwight says someone committed a crime, and that he didn’t become a Lackawanna County volunteer sheriff’s deputy to make friends.

cite.t: So, yesterday Dwight found half a joint in the parking lot. Which is unfortunate because as it turns out, Dwight finding drugs is more dangerous than most people using drugs.

trivia.q: In “Drug Testing”, why can’t Jim speak for most of the day?
w: He lost a bet to Dwight
He took a vow of silence for charity
trivia.why: Under the rules of jinx he has to buy her a Coke first, and the vending machine is sold out.

cite.t: No, no, no, no talking. Jim is not allowed to talk until after he buys me a coke. Those are the rules of jinx, and they are unflinchingly rigid.

trivia.q: In “Conflict Resolution”, how does Michael settle Oscar and Angela’s fight over her baby poster?
trivia.a: Turn it into a T-shirt for Oscar
w: Hang it in the break room
trivia.why: Michael says Oscar will never have to see it and Angela can see it whenever she looks at him, and he picks it over Pam’s Tuesdays-and-Thursdays compromise.

cite.t: Okay, that is called a compromise. And it is style 3. And it is not ideal. To sum up, win/win - make the poster into a t-shirt, win/lose - take the poster down, compromise - Tuesdays and Thursdays. And the answer is... make the poster into a t-shirt! Win/win.

trivia.q: In “Casino Night”, what does Jim finally tell Pam after Roy heads home?
trivia.a: That he is in love with her
w: That he is back with Katy
That Roy is cheating on her
trivia.why: Pam tells him she can’t, and Jim apologizes for misinterpreting their friendship.

cite.t: I was just... I'm in love with you.

trivia.q: In “Casino Night”, who ends the evening as chip leader and wins the mini-fridge from Vance Refrigeration?
trivia.why: Kevin, who claims a World Series of Poker title, loses an all-in hand to Phyllis, while Creed says he has never owned a refrigerator.

cite.t: Excuse me. Big moment. The evening's chip leader and winner of this beautiful mini-refrigerator courtesy of Vance Refrigeration, Creed Bratton, Dunder Mifflin!

trivia.q: In “Fun Run”, what disease is Michael’s 5k meant to raise awareness of?
trivia.why: Dwight put a garbage bag with a bat in it over Meredith’s head, so after Michael hit her with his car, the hospital gave her the rabies vaccine.

cite.t: Michael Scott's Dunder-Mifflin, Scranton, Meredith Palmer memorial, celebrity rabies awareness, fun run race for the cure, this is Pam.

trivia.q: In “Fun Run”, what does Michael carbo-load on right before the race?
trivia.why: He also turns down water in solidarity with rabies victims, and during the race he says the fettuccine is sitting in his stomach “like a rock.”

cite.t: OK, fettuccine alfredo, time to carbo-load.

trivia.q: In “Dunder Mifflin Infinity”, where does Michael end up after trusting his car’s GPS?
trivia.why: Dwight shouts that there’s a lake there, Michael insists the machine knows where it’s going, and they end up calling a cab from Lake Scranton.

cite.t: Yes, we need a cab at Lake Scranton, at the end of East Mountain Road, in the lake.

trivia.q: In “Dunder Mifflin Infinity”, Dwight tries to replace Angela’s dead cat with one from the farm. What is the new cat’s name?
trivia.why: Mose calls him Garbage because he likes to eat garbage, and Dwight adds that he killed an entire family of raccoons. Angela still wants Sprinkles.

cite.t: And his name is... Garbage. Mose calls him Garbage because he likes to eat garbage. Don't you Garbage?

trivia.q: In “Launch Party”, why does Michael keep the pizza delivery kid shut in the conference room?
w: He thinks the kid is a corporate spy
He wants him to sing at the party
trivia.why: The half-off coupon only covered orders of two pizzas, Michael had ordered eight, and Jim points out that this makes the kid a hostage.

cite.t: Yes you are, yes you are, and you will come out when you decide to give me a discount on the pizza. Please, thank you.

trivia.q: In “Money”, Jim and Pam spend a night at Schrute Farms. Which themed room do they pick?
trivia.why: Dwight offers three rooms, American, Irrigation and Night-Time, and promises them Mose’s table-making demonstration.

cite.t: I'll put you down for Irrigation. Well then, do you have any special needs or diertary restrictions?

trivia.q: In “Local Ad”, what online world does Dwight insist is “not a game”?
trivia.why: His avatar is also a paper salesman named Dwight. The only difference is that he can fly.

cite.t: Second Life is not a game. It is a multi-user virtual environment. It doesn't have points or scores, it doesn't have winners or losers.

trivia.q: In “Branch Wars”, what do Michael and Dwight try to steal from the Utica branch?
trivia.why: Michael calls it Utica’s crown jewel. He and Dwight end up wedged between the copier and a stairwell railing just as Karen comes back.

cite.t: We found something far better, their crown jewel. Their industrial copier.

trivia.q: In “Branch Wars”, Pam and Oscar founded the Finer Things Club with one other person. Who?
trivia.why: They meet once a month to discuss books and art, with no paper, plastic or work talk allowed. Andy is told he is not in.

cite.t: Oscar, Toby, and I are founding members of the Finer Things Club. We meet once a month to discuss books and art, celebrate culture in a very civilized way. Sometimes the debate can get heated, but we're always respectful. There is no paper, no plastic, and no work talk allowed. It's very exclusive.

trivia.q: In “Survivor Man”, Jim tries to fold the month’s birthdays into one party. Which ice cream cake does Andy lobby for?
trivia.why: When Jim tries to change the plan, Angela is already stuck with devil’s food, peach cobbler, Fudgie the Whale and mushroom caps.

cite.t: Me likey the ice cream cake, okay? Fudgie the Whale.

trivia.q: In “The Deposition”, what does Jan hand to her lawyer to use against Michael?
trivia.why: The lawyer reads an entry about Jamaica into the record, and Jan calls it even because Michael emailed her topless photo to the whole company.

cite.t: Alright, I stole your diary and gave it to my lawyer. You emailed a topless photo of me to everyone in our company. Let's call it even.

trivia.q: In “Dinner Party”, what does Jan throw at Michael’s plasma TV?
trivia.why: The neighbours call the police, Michael offers to take the fall, and Dwight is the only guest who offers him a place to stay.

cite.t: Oh... yes. There was some screaming but... um... my girlfriend... threw a dundie at my TV. Plasma.

trivia.q: In “Chair Model”, Dwight tracks down the woman on page 85 of the office supply catalogue. What does he find out?
trivia.a: She died in a car accident
trivia.why: Dwight works back through the furniture company, the ad agency, a Spanish photographer and a Wilkes-Barre modelling agency before delivering the news.

cite.t: The furniture company gave me the name of the advertising agency. They gave me the name of the photographer. The photographer, a Spaniard, used a Wilkes-Barre modeling agency. The agency gave me the following information. Deborah Shoshlefski. 142 South Windsor Lane. Dead. Car accident. Case closed.

trivia.q: In “Night Out”, what does Toby announce just before he hops the fence?
w: He’s going back to the seminary
trivia.why: He says he has thought about it for a long time now and is finally going to do it, then says he will just hop the fence and jog home.

cite.t: More like "Everyone let's get your boss laid Saturday." I have an announcement uh, to make. I am moving to Costa Rica. Thought about it for a long time now. And I'm finally gonna do it. So, I'm just gonna hop the fence and jog home now.

trivia.q: In “Did I Stutter?”, why is Pam stuck wearing her backup glasses?
w: She lost a contact in the parking lot
Her contacts gave her pink eye
Jim sat on her contact case
trivia.why: She says she slept over at a friend’s house. Michael tells her the glasses move her in the wrong direction, and Kevin says every girlfriend he’s had wore glasses.

cite.t: Um... yeah, I slept over at a, uh, friend's house and, I forgot my contact solution, so... I had to wear my backup glasses... Shut up.

trivia.q: In “Job Fair”, what does Pam drive twenty miles round trip back to the office to fetch?
trivia.why: Michael had told her one sheet was all it takes to make a difference, and then a student signed his name on it.

cite.t: I just drove twenty miles round-trip back to the office to get Michael a single sheet of white paper. So, I could have just had them fax it to me, I guess.

trivia.q: In “Goodbye, Toby”, Michael wants Toby’s going-away party to be spectacular. What does Phyllis end up calling around to rent?
trivia.why: Michael saw one in a movie where you drink a potion and float. Angela refuses to touch his “foot money”, so Phyllis takes over the party.

cite.t: Hi. Are there any local companies that rent antigravity machines?

trivia.q: In “Weight Loss”, where does Jim finally propose to Pam?
trivia.why: They agree to meet halfway at the Exit 17 rest stop where a soda once exploded on Jim. Pam complains that it wasn’t really halfway.

cite.t: The rest stop where that soda exploded on me. Exit 17, I think. 1 o'clock.

trivia.q: In “Weight Loss”, what is Kelly drinking for all three meals on her cleanse diet?
trivia.a: Maple syrup, lemon juice and cayenne
trivia.why: Water is the fourth ingredient. She is on day three and has already bought size 2 bikinis online.

cite.t: I am on the third day of my cleanse diet. All I have to do is drink maple syrup, lemon juice, cayenne pepper and water for all three meals. Um, I just bought some bikinis online, size 2. So ... gonna look amazing.

trivia.q: In “Business Ethics”, Meredith admits to sleeping with a supplier for six years. Besides discounts, what else did she get out of it?
trivia.why: The rep is Bruce Meyers from Hammermill, and corporate HR calls the arrangement a grey area because the discount helps the company.

cite.t: Well for the past six years I have been sleeping with him in exchange for discounts on our supplies and Outback Steakhouse gift certificates.

trivia.q: In “Baby Shower”, what does Jan name her baby?
trivia.why: Jan had the baby before the shower, Michael missed the birth, and Kevin points out that the baby ruins all the planned games.

cite.t: ...trid Levinson. Hi! Astrid, this is everybody, look. This is your family. You're going to know them for the rest of your life.

trivia.q: In “Crime Aid”, what big-ticket item does Michael promise for the auction, until it mysteriously goes missing?
trivia.why: He claims front-row seats and backstage passes, then announces they must have been stolen. Holly admits they always seemed too good to be true.

cite.t: Michael scored the big ticket item. Springsteen tickets! The boss scored the boss.

trivia.q: In “Employee Transfer”, where does corporate send Holly once it learns she and Michael are dating?
trivia.why: It was her old branch, and Darryl comes along on the drive up, asking Michael if he will make that trip every weekend.

cite.t: When Corporate found out that we were dating, they decided they were going to transfer Holly back to her old branch, in Nashua, New Hampshire.

trivia.q: In “Customer Survey”, Kelly fakes bad survey scores for Jim and Dwight. Why?
trivia.why: It was her America’s Got Talent finale party, and Jim works it out when Ryan says the matching mugs were her party favours.

cite.t: OK, all right. OK, I did it. All right? I lied, whatever. Just fire me. But you know what? I did it because you guys didn't come to my party, and you said you would try to and then you didn't even show up, and so you're bad friends.

trivia.q: In “Business Trip”, which city do Michael, Andy and Oscar fly to for a client presentation?
trivia.why: David Wallace admits it is pretty tough to find anyone who wants to go up there in mid-November, and Michael is thrilled to be flying business class.

cite.t: I was happy to send Michael on this trip. He's been feeling pretty down since we had to transfer Holly up to New Hampshire. But this little perk really seemed to turn him around. And it's pretty tough to find somebody who wants to go up to Winnipeg mid-November.

trivia.q: In “Frame Toby”, what do the police find in the bag Michael planted in Toby’s desk?
trivia.why: Michael paid the Vance Refrigeration guys 500 dollars for what he thought was two pounds of weed. The officer finds basil, mozzarella and salad dressing.

cite.t: Yeah it's, uh, a caprese salad. There's a little bit of, uh, mozerella right there.

trivia.q: In “Frame Toby”, what does Jim buy for himself and Pam without telling her?
trivia.why: It’s the house he grew up in, shag carpet from the ’70s and all, and he bought it partly to help out his mom.

cite.t: Today's a big day. Today's the day that I show Pam the house that I bought for us. Without telling her. But it's my parent's house, the house I grew up in and yeah, I bought it kind of impulsively. I mean, the price was good and I was helping out my mom. It's got shag carpets. I mean you can't blame my parents it was the 70's. And why would you want to buy ugly wood from trees when you can have paneling? And a painting of some creepy clowns that is apparently crucial to the structural integrity of the building. She's gonna love it. Right?

trivia.q: In “The Surplus”, Michael ends the week with a fur coat from Burlington Coat Factory. What happens to him as he walks out?
trivia.a: He gets doused in fake blood
w: He gets stuck in the revolving door
trivia.why: He put the coat on a credit card expecting a $645 bonus, but the office chose new chairs, so the bonus never came.

cite.t: What did we learn this week? Well, one, thanks to me, my team is much, much faster at coming to decisions than I thought they would be. Number two, never buy a fur coat with a credit card until you absolutely have the money to pay for it. And three, you should know that some people think it's cool to throw buckets of fake blood on you as you are walking out of Burlington Coat Factory.

trivia.q: In “Moroccan Christmas”, what happens to Meredith at Phyllis’s party?
trivia.a: She sets her hair on fire
w: She falls off the conference table
She gets stuck in the elevator
trivia.why: Michael stops the party for an intervention and later tries to check her into Sunrise Rehab.

cite.t: Alright, no, no, no. No. That is the image, I think we can all agree is very disgusting. But you know what, Meredith, you lit your hair on fire today. What about tomorrow.? What is going to happen when you come into work and you're dead?

trivia.q: In “Moroccan Christmas”, which sold-out toy has Dwight been hoarding to resell?
trivia.why: Dwight calls the dolls commodities, like gold or oil. Darryl buys the last one and tries to flip it to a begging Toby for 400 dollars.

cite.t: Oh, hey, is that Princess Unicorn? I thought they were all sold out.

trivia.q: In “The Duel”, how does Andy attack Dwight in the parking lot?
trivia.why: He creeps up at walking pace, and Oscar points out that a Prius is silent under five miles per hour.

cite.t: Andy's running over Dwight with his car.

trivia.q: In “The Duel”, Andy calls to cancel his wedding cake. What shape was it?
trivia.why: He spells his last name for the bakery as B-E-R, N-A, R-D.

cite.t: Yes, hi, my last name is Bernard, and I would like to cancel a wedding cake that I had ordered. B-E-R, N-A, R-D. Yeah, the one shaped like a sailboat... Yep, that's the one.

trivia.q: In “Prince Family Paper”, which actress does the office argue over, hot or not?
trivia.why: Kevin insists hot and beautiful are different things, and the first show of hands ends five to five.

cite.t: No one cares. Who thinks that Hillary Swank is hot, raise your hand. Okay, and who thinks Hillary Swank is not hot, raise your hand.

trivia.q: In “Stress Relief”, what happens to Stanley during Dwight’s fake fire?
w: He gets stuck in the stairwell
trivia.why: Dwight’s position is that Stanley was attacked by his own heart. Michael follows it up with a CPR class.

cite.t: I just want to say for the record, I did not kill anyone. Stanley was attacked by his own heart. And he should be released from the hospital and back in the office in a couple days.

trivia.q: In “Stress Relief”, what does Dwight do to the CPR training dummy?
trivia.why: Dwight says he didn’t think the movie was realistic, but it turns out it is. The dummy cost 3,500 dollars, and Michael tells David Wallace the lesson is not to do it to a real person.

cite.t: Could you tell me why you had to cut the face off the dummy?

trivia.q: In “Lecture Circuit: Part 1”, what bulky item does Michael pack for the road trip with Pam, just in case?
trivia.why: Pam calls it a sled. Michael says you never know when you’re going to find a snowy hill.

cite.t: No! That is a toboggan, you never know when you're gonna find a snowy hill so... Every magician has a hot assistant, and every rock star has a roadie, and Pam is my hot roadie.

trivia.q: In “Lecture Circuit: Part 2”, what does Kelly admit she did after a boyfriend dumped her?
trivia.why: It turned out to be his father’s boat. Dwight is grilling her about her juvie record, and she says she wanted it to be like “Thelma and Louise”, but with a boat.

cite.t: My boyfriend dumped me, so, I stole his boat. I mean, he told me it was his boat. It was actually his father's. And I just thought it'd be really romantic, like 'Thelma and Louise,' but with, like, a boat. And it was the worst year of my life. And I can't believe that you guys are making me talk about this on my birthday!

trivia.q: In “Blood Drive”, Angela says two men once fought a duel over her in Ohio. What were their names?
trivia.why: Oscar assumes she means Dwight and Andy, but this was years earlier, back when she lived in Ohio.

cite.t: No, this was years ago when I was living in Ohio. John Mark and John David.

trivia.q: In “Golden Ticket”, which movie character is Michael pretending to be when he launches his promotion?
trivia.why: He slipped five golden tickets into paper shipments, each one worth ten percent off an order.

cite.t: Oh, no, no, no, no. I am not Michael. I am Willy Wonkaaaaa.

trivia.q: In “Golden Ticket”, which client ends up with all five golden tickets?
trivia.why: Darryl explains that Blue Cross gets three pallets a week. The discount pleases them so much they make Dunder Mifflin their exclusive supplier.

cite.t: Sir. I placed a bunch of golden tickets into five separate boxes and some how they all ended up with Blue Cross. How does this happen?

trivia.q: In “New Boss”, what is Jim wearing the day he first meets Charles Miner?
trivia.why: He wore it to mess with Dwight’s memo about professionalism, and it is the first thing Charles asks him about.

cite.t: Why are you wearing a tuxedo?

trivia.q: In “New Boss”, how does Michael personalize the welcome bagels for Charles?
w: Spells his name in cream cheese
trivia.why: Michael herds everyone into the break room, announces there is nothing in there, and saves the bagels for the conference room. He says they took him all night.

cite.t: Surprise! As you can see, I turned the bagels from O's into C's, for Charles.

trivia.q: In “Two Weeks”, Pam walks out to join the Michael Scott Paper Company. What job does she insist on?
trivia.why: She says she doesn’t want to be a receptionist anymore, turns down executive assistant, and Michael agrees on the spot. Kevin takes over her phones.

cite.t: Salesman.

trivia.q: In “Dream Team”, where is the Michael Scott Paper Company based on Pam’s first day?
trivia.why: Pam says Apple started in a garage, so they already have a leg up. Then a letter arrives saying the condo agreement forbids running a business there.

cite.t: Today is my first day at my new job at Michael Scott Paper Company Incorporated. You know, Apple Computers started in a garage. And we're starting in a condo. So we already have a leg up on Apple. Look, it's official!

trivia.q: In “Michael Scott Paper Company”, what does Michael plan for the company’s grand opening?
trivia.why: His e-vite got six yeses, one maybe and eleven noes, with 788 people yet to reply.

cite.t: We wait, and hope that people show up to the pancake luncheon.

trivia.q: In “Heavy Competition”, Dwight breaks his lunch truce with Michael. Which sandwich does he ask Michael to order for him?
trivia.why: Dwight knew Michael would eat it out of spite, and it’s the restaurant’s worst sandwich. While they wait for him, he raids their office.

cite.t: And I knew that you would do that. The meatball parm is their worst sandwich!

trivia.q: In “Broke”, the Michael Scott Paper Company buys a used van with Korean writing on the side. What do they think it says?
trivia.why: They got it at a used car lot, and Pam says the other choice was an old school bus with an owl living in it.

cite.t: We got the van at a used car lot. We think it says "Alleluia Church of Scranton." in Korean. It was either this or an old school bus with an owl living in it.

trivia.q: In “Casual Friday”, how does Dwight hide his call for a secret warehouse meeting?
w: The back of the lunch menu
trivia.why: The memo is titled “New File System”, and the message shows up when held over heat. Dwight admits the ink was urine.

cite.t: When held over heat the invisible ink will reveal that everyone should meet at the warehouse immediately. Do not ask me where I got the invisible ink. Urine. It was urine.

trivia.q: In “Cafe Disco”, why are Jim and Pam heading to a courthouse in Youngstown, Ohio?
w: To sign the papers on the house
trivia.why: Youngstown is the closest place to get a marriage licence without a three-day wait. Staying for one more dance at Michael’s Cafe Disco, they decide they want a real wedding after all.

cite.t: So, it turns out it's the closest place to get a marriage license without a 3 day waiting period.

trivia.q: In “Company Picnic”, which branch’s closing does Michael accidentally reveal in his skit with Holly?
trivia.why: In the SlumDunder Mifflinaire sketch Michael answers “B, Buffalo! Final answer!” with the Buffalo staff in the crowd, and nobody had told them yet.

cite.t: We're- we're closing the Buffalo branch.

trivia.q: In “Gossip”, what stunt craze do Michael, Dwight and Andy act out around the office in the cold open?
trivia.why: Jim explains the goal is getting from point A to point B creatively, with point B being the hospital.

cite.t: This... is Parkour. Internet sensation of 2004. And it was in one of the Bond films. It's pretty impressive. The goal is to get from point A to point B as creatively as possible, so technically they are doing Parkour, as long as point A is delusion and point B is the hospital.

trivia.q: In “The Meeting”, how does Michael try to sneak into Jim’s private meeting with David Wallace?
trivia.why: Andy wheels the cart in as cover and talks up a firm cheddar and an aged parmesan from Wisconsin.

cite.t: You know when they say it's so crazy it just might work? Well, I don't believe that. I say go for the air-tight plan and that is why I am having Andy wheel me into the conference room inside a makeshift cheese cart. It is just elegant.

trivia.q: In “The Promotion”, what do Jim and Michael place on employees’ photos to decide who gets a raise?
trivia.why: Each one stands for half a percent, and the staff are furious when they find the photos covered in them.

cite.t: Each Boston Baked Bean represents half a percent raise. We each got 24 beans, so the idea is, you place the bean on the picture of who you think deserv-- who's that?

trivia.q: In “Niagara: Part 1”, which of Pam’s relatives threatens to skip the wedding after Jim’s toast lets the pregnancy slip?
trivia.why: Mema asks why Pam can’t drink, and Michael makes it worse by talking about the couple living together.

cite.t: Mema's not coming to the wedding. She's leaving tomorrow morning.

trivia.q: In “Niagara: Part 2”, where do Jim and Pam secretly get married before the church ceremony?
trivia.a: On a boat at the falls
trivia.why: Jim bought the boat tickets as a backup the day he saw the YouTube video, and says the boat was Plan C.

cite.t: I bought those boat tickets the day I saw that You Tube video. I knew we'd need a back-up plan. The boat was actually Plan C. The church was Plan B and Plan A was marrying her a long, long time ago. Pretty much the day I met her.

trivia.q: In “Mafia”, what is Grotti, the man Dwight and Andy are sure is a mobster, actually selling?
trivia.why: Andy insists insurance is a classic mob front, and Oscar later notes that Michael has just stood up to an agent from Mutual of Harrisburg.

cite.t: Wait, when did we start talking about the mob? The guy was trying to sell me insurance.

trivia.q: In “The Lover”, whose mother does Michael reveal he has been dating?
trivia.why: Michael tells Jim it is Helene, whom he met at the wedding, and Pam later yells at him to stop dating her mother.

cite.t: Pam's mom, Helene. Remember from your wedding?

trivia.q: In “Koi Pond”, what does the security tape of Michael’s fall reveal?
w: He jumped in on a dare
trivia.why: Oscar spots it first. Dwight says to play it again and that Jim purposefully leaned away, which Jim tries to pass off as freezing up.

cite.t: Play it again. He purposefully leaned away and let you fall in.

trivia.q: In “Double Date”, what age does Helene turn at her birthday lunch, to Michael’s alarm?
trivia.why: She has claimed to be 49 for nine years running, and Michael ends up dumping her on her birthday.

cite.t: No. I'm 58.

trivia.q: In “Murder”, in which Southern city is Michael’s murder mystery game set?
trivia.why: The game, Belles, Bourbon and Bullets, opens in 1955 with local magnate Bill Bourbon killed the night before.

cite.t: What? Oh my God! There has been a murder. There's been a murder in Savannah.

trivia.q: In “Shareholder Meeting”, what is the name of the recycling mascot Dwight has played for the office every Earth Day?
trivia.why: Jim notes that one year the character renounced Earth Day and vowed to destroy the planet he once loved.

cite.t: Five years ago, corporate said we had to start a recycling program for Earth Day so Dwight took the lead on that and introduced us to a very close friend of his named Recyclops.

trivia.q: In “Scott’s Tots”, what does Michael hand the students instead of the college tuition he promised them?
trivia.why: He points out that they are lithium, and later offers to buy one student’s books if he can find a way to pay for college.

cite.t: Okay, hold on. Hold on. Now I can't pay for your college. But you don't have to go to class to be in class. Online courses are a viable option to a traditional college experience. And the best way to access those courses is with your own personal laptop. Which is rendered useless without batteries, and I have one for each of you.

trivia.q: In “Secret Santa”, after the office votes for Phyllis as Santa, who does Michael come back dressed as?
trivia.why: He shows up claiming to bring glad Christmas tidings and to remind everyone of the true meaning of Christmas.

cite.t: Behold! Jesus Christ. And I bring to you glad Christmas tidings. I want to remind everyone the true meaning of Christmas. Those of you who wish to join me, that's great. I'm excited by that. And those of you who don't, I forgive you. But I never forget.

trivia.q: In “The Banker”, what is the name of the “virtual helper” Dwight built, which greets the visiting investment banker?
trivia.why: It welcomes Eric Ward by name, says the Pacific is the world’s largest ocean, and argues with Michael about lobster.

cite.t: Dwight? Who is this Dwight? Oh! You mean Dwight Schrute, the company's top salesman and the creator of Computron. I wear many hats but the one I'm currently wearing is that of gracious host. Welcome.

trivia.q: In “Sabre”, which Hollywood actor hosts the orientation video from the new owners?
trivia.why: In the video he asks new employees whether they have ever tasted a rainbow, and promises they will at Sabre.

cite.t: So you've just been bought by Sabre. You've probably got a lot of questions. Hi. I'm Christian Slater. What's it like to work for Sabre? Let's find out together. Working at Sabre means taking on the challenge of the road that rises to meet you. Sabre is respecting the past, but opening a window to the future. Have you ever tasted a rainbow? At Sabre, you will.

trivia.q: In “Manager and Salesman”, how does Andy try to keep his Valentine’s card for Erin from looking too eager?
trivia.a: Gives cards to the whole office
w: Signs it from a secret admirer
Leaves it unsigned on her chair
trivia.why: The plan backfires when Erin decides Kelly got the more romantic card.

cite.t: Valentine's Day, right around the corner. Erin and I have been on zero dates. So I got her a Valentine's Day card, but I didn't wanna seem "too eager," so I got cards for everyone in the whole office to kind of dilute it a little bit.

trivia.q: In “The Delivery: Part 1”, what name does Andy say he went by until he was about six?
trivia.why: His parents gave the name to his newborn brother and picked Andrew for him out of a baby name book.

cite.t: Guys. Word of advice. Speaking as a former baby. Don't get too hung up on baby names. I was named Walter Jr. after my father until I was about six or so, when my parents changed their minds.

trivia.q: In “The Delivery: Part 2”, what do Jim and Pam name their daughter?
trivia.why: Jim announces her full name, Cecelia Marie Halpert, and she goes by Cece from then on.

cite.t: Her name is Cecelia Marie Halpert.

trivia.q: In “St. Patrick’s Day”, what does Dwight call the giant workstation Jim finds in place of his desk when he comes back from leave with the baby?
trivia.why: Dwight admits he got hooked on it and begs Jim for five more minutes before it is taken apart.

cite.t: Dweedle Dee and Dweedle Dumb-ass have been away on maternity leave. Now Dweedle Dumb-ass is back, and we have a problem. Yes, getting hooked on Mega-Desk was my own damn fault. But ... I don't care about assigning blame. All I care about is Mega-Desk. That is all I care about. Getting. More. Mega-Desk.

trivia.q: In “New Leads”, what do Michael and Dwight bring back from the city dump instead of the lost Sabre leads?
trivia.why: The leads were hidden in the kitchen trash, which Erin emptied into the dumpster with Toby’s baba ganoush, and Phyllis refuses to sit on the chair.

cite.t: We have an awesome bean bag chair that's perfect for the break room.

trivia.q: In “Happy Hour”, which warehouse worker is Oscar secretly hoping to get to know when he pushes for an office happy hour?
trivia.why: Darryl sees right through the plan, and later tells Oscar that Matt is an okay dude but a dummy.

cite.t: Look, just be straight with me, man. You can be gay with Matt, just be straight with me.

trivia.q: In “Secretary’s Day”, Michael lets slip to Erin over lunch that Andy was once engaged to which coworker?
trivia.why: Erin blows up in the middle of Andy’s Secretary’s Day toast, shouting that she knows about the engagement and that Michael told her.

cite.t: I know about Angela! I know that you were engaged to her and that you were sleeping with her! Michael told me.

trivia.q: In “Body Language”, who wins the spot in Sabre’s minority executive training program?
trivia.why: Dwight first pushed her to apply, thinking she could be bought with fashion magazines, then tried to swap in Hide at the last minute.

cite.t: Everyone, it is my pleasure to announce our newest member of the Sabre minority executive training program. Kelly Rajnigandha Kapoor. All right.

trivia.q: In “The Cover-Up”, what does Michael learn when he confronts Donna about cheating on him?
trivia.why: Donna tells him he is the other man, and Michael realizes he is the mistress.

cite.t: It's you. I'm married.

trivia.q: In “The Chump”, what does Angela vow to own by the time her fight with Dwight over their baby contract is over?
trivia.why: A lawyer reviews their childrearing contract and calls it solid, and Angela points out the farm is 60 acres.

cite.t: Alleged? I'm going to own your farm by the time this is over.

trivia.q: In “Whistleblower”, who does Pam admit she told about the Sabre printers catching fire?
trivia.why: She was trying to top the woman’s story about a trip to Vietnam, and the woman’s husband is a reporter.

cite.t: Okay. I'm talking to this woman at daycare...

trivia.q: In “Nepotism”, how does Pam try to make up for ruining Jim’s prank on Dwight?
w: Moves his desk into the bathroom
trivia.why: Kevin rearranges the buttons, but Pam ends up stuck inside with Dwight, who insists on a pee corner.

cite.t: Oh, hey Jim. Some prankster switched the elevator buttons on Dwight.

trivia.q: In “Counseling”, what job title does Pam claim she was quietly given months earlier?
trivia.why: She says the paperwork got lost, and Gabe asks her to get every department head’s signature to back it up.

cite.t: Well, as I am sure you know, for the past few months, I've been the Office Administrator. Since right before you guys took over.

trivia.q: In “Andy’s Play”, which musical is Andy cast in?
trivia.why: Michael had auditioned too, and Darryl realizes the man playing the lead is his plumber.

cite.t: We're the cast of Sweeney Todd

trivia.q: In “Sex Ed”, what is the blemish on Michael’s face that sends him into a panic?
trivia.why: Kevin points out that a cold sore is herpes, so Michael starts calling his ex-girlfriends.

cite.t: Yup, just a cold sore.

trivia.q: In “The Sting”, which rival company does star salesman Danny Cordray work for?
trivia.why: Dwight says Danny steals more clients from Dunder Mifflin than anyone, and it turns out Pam once went on a couple of dates with him.

cite.t: The best salesman ever. He works for Osprey Paper over in Throop, steals more clients from Dunder-Mifflin than anyone.

trivia.q: In “Costume Contest”, who wins the coupon book in the office costume contest?
trivia.why: He came as a “rational consumer” after griping that the book was worth about forty bucks, and Creed praises his Edward James Olmos costume.

cite.t: Okay, everyone, I've tallied the votes, and the winner... of the costume celebration spectacular... and the Scranton Wilkes-Barre coupon book... Oscar Martinez.

trivia.q: In “Christening”, where is the church youth group bus that Michael and Andy jump aboard headed?
trivia.why: The group is leaving for three months to build a school in Cabo Corrientes, and Andy follows Michael on.

cite.t: Hey. Hey. Is this the bus to Mexico?

trivia.q: In “Viewing Party”, which TV show do Erin and Gabe host a party to watch?
trivia.why: Erin hopes for a mash-up of Michael and Gabe, but Michael cranks the volume and tries to move the party to the bedroom.

cite.t: Gabe and I are having a party, and everyone's invited, and it's at his house apartment and we're gonna watch Glee.

trivia.q: In “WUPHF.com”, when Oscar asks Ryan about the money situation, how long does Ryan say WUPHF can keep going?
trivia.why: Ryan treats it as good news, and Oscar has to point out that the deadline means bankruptcy.

cite.t: We have nine solid days. I love these questions. Keep 'em coming.

trivia.q: In “China”, after her fake-building bluff falls apart, how does Pam make Dwight, the new landlord, stop his cutbacks?
trivia.a: Shows him a rule he is breaking
trivia.why: Article nineteen requires comfortable temperatures and adequate lighting, and Dwight orders Nate to re-ply the toilet paper.

cite.t: Read article nineteen. There are suitable standards that you have to maintain the building at that includes comfortable temperatures and adequate lighting. It also means no more cutting the tampons in two, and no more tampering with the toilet paper.

trivia.q: In “Classy Christmas”, why does Toby take a leave of absence, bringing Holly back to Scranton?
trivia.why: He is picked as a juror on a high-profile case, which the office guesses is the Scranton Strangler trial.

cite.t: Uh, no, the opposite. I was actually selected to be a juror on a very high-profile case.

trivia.q: In “Ultimatum”, what ultimatum has Holly given her boyfriend AJ?
trivia.why: Michael says the day will be the best or worst of his life, but AJ never proposes and Holly stays with him anyway.

cite.t: Today will either be the best or the worst day of my life. Holly gave AJ an ultimatum. He either proposes by New Year's or they break up. Now, if she's engaged, I'm gonna go crazy, and I'm gonna start attacking people. If she's not engaged, in all honesty, I may just burn this whole place to the ground out of happiness. Either way, I am going to need some talking down. And nobody talks me down like myself in a video talking me down.

trivia.q: In “The Seminar”, which game does Erin keep losing to Gabe, so he gets to pick the movie?
trivia.why: Pam and Oscar start feeding her words after a losing streak that meant sitting through The Shining, Rosemary’s Baby and The Ring.

cite.t: I'm playing Scrabble with Gabe, and I've never won a game.

trivia.q: In “The Search”, how does Michael end up lost in Scranton without his wallet or phone?
trivia.a: Jim leaves him at a gas station
w: He gets off the wrong bus
Dwight drops him at the wrong building
trivia.why: Jim had to rush off because Pam’s mom locked Cece in the car, leaving Michael’s wallet and phone on the seat, so Holly, Dwight and Erin set out to find him.

cite.t: Yes, and your mom got a very well deserved day off. So here's the thing though. I left Michael at the gas station on Benet.

trivia.q: In “PDA”, what Valentine’s Day surprise does Gabe set up for Erin?
trivia.why: Gabe corrects her for calling it a scavenger hunt, and Andy helps her with a jigsaw puzzle clue.

cite.t: Oh, close. It's a romantic treasure hunt. A scavenger hunt is where you find items from a master list. This is where you follow clues that lead to a prize. Common misuse. Good luck.

trivia.q: In “Threat Level Midnight”, what is the name of the villain who hides a bomb at the NHL All-Star Game?
trivia.why: He also takes the concession stand workers hostage. The game is sold out and the only way in is in uniform, so Michael Scarn has to learn hockey.

cite.t: It's your old enemy, Goldenface. He's after the NHL All Star Game. He's hidden a bomb somewhere in the stadium. Scarn, this one is personal for me. I own the stadium. I can't see it blown up. It's my retirement plan.

trivia.q: In “Todd Packer”, where do Jim and Dwight trick Packer into thinking he has a cushy new job?
trivia.why: Packer brags that he is a huge alligator nerd, and Dwight throws in a free butterbeer at Harry Potter World.

cite.t: Apparently, as soon as corporate found out I wanted to come in off the road, Jo offered me a cushy new job in Tallahassee. And here's the best part. I'm a huge alligator nerd. I can name you every genus, every sub species. Also I'm a huge boob nerd.

trivia.q: In “Garage Sale”, after trading up from a thumbtack to a telescope, what does Dwight swap the telescope for?
trivia.why: Jim baits him with Professor Copperfield’s Miracle Legumes from Jamaica while pretending he does not want to sell.

cite.t: I started with a thumb tack and traded my way to a telescope. But in a way the most valuable thing here wasn't the telescope at all. No, it was this... packet of beans. So I traded the telescope for it. And I can just go buy another telescope.

trivia.q: In “Training Day”, where do Michael and Deangelo chat the night before his first day without realizing who the other is?
trivia.why: They talk for about 20 minutes before Michael learns the stranger is his replacement.

cite.t: I'm at the bar. The bar that's located in the lobby of the hotel.

trivia.q: In “Michael’s Last Dundies”, how many minutes does the office sing that Michael has worked there?
trivia.why: Andy says they sat down and did the math, and the song compares it to watching Die Hard 80,000 times.

cite.t: Nine million, nine hundred eighty six thousand minutes! We actually sat down, and did the math.

trivia.q: In “Goodbye, Michael”, what does Michael keep from most of the office about his departure?
trivia.a: He is leaving a day early
w: He is taking Dwight with him
trivia.why: He tells everyone tomorrow is his last day, but Jim works it out and plays along with plans for lunch tomorrow.

cite.t: Yes, so I know I told everybody that tomorrow is my last day, but I'm, I'm gonna be leaving tonight. I head to the airport at four. And I have said goodbye to half of them.

trivia.q: In “The Inner Circle”, what motivational routine does Deangelo perform even though he has none of his props?
trivia.why: He turns down Andy’s spare balls, mimes the whole act to music, and Jim wonders what a fake juggling routine could gain him.

cite.t: Sorry, I never touch another juggler's instruments. You know, we're all here, I've got the music cued, why don't I just do my routine without the juggling balls? Prepare... to go into the danger zone.

trivia.q: In “Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager”, what does Dwight do that costs him the manager job?
trivia.a: Fires a gun in the office
trivia.why: The shot bursts Andy’s eardrum, and Jo tells Dwight he does not fit the job and names a search committee instead.

cite.t: Jo... I accidentally fired a gun in the office today.

trivia.q: In “Search Committee”, where does one manager candidate keep saying he needs a two-week trip right after he starts?
trivia.why: Jim says he was good otherwise, and from then on calls him “Finger Lakes guy.”

cite.t: This guy was good. Although, he did keep saying that he needed two weeks off right at the beginning for a trip to the finger lakes. Seriously. Every five minutes, he was like, "just making sure the finger lakes thing is clear."

trivia.q: In “The List”, what internet fad does the office pick up, much to Oscar’s annoyance?
trivia.why: Kelly ends up planking on top of a cabinet and then announces she can’t get down.

cite.t: Planking is a very stupid and dangerous trend. Basically, you lie like a plank in weird places. That's it. Sometimes you get run over. Welcome to the Internet.

trivia.q: In “The Incentive”, what do the staff get tattooed on Andy’s backside after pooling their points?
trivia.why: Andy had offered a tattoo of their choice for 5,000 points, and he loved the result because Nard Dog is his “nickity-name.”

cite.t: It's a Nard Dog! That's my nickity-name! I love it, I love it!

trivia.q: In “Lotto”, whose birthday did the warehouse crew play to win the lottery?
trivia.why: Darryl had dropped out of the warehouse lotto pool after his promotion, so he got nothing from the $950,000 jackpot.

cite.t: When I worked in the warehouse, I was part of that lotto pool. They won ... playing my birthday.

trivia.q: In “Garden Party”, who secretly wrote the one-of-a-kind garden party guide that Dwight relies on?
trivia.why: Dwight bragged that he bought the only copy in the world online for two dollars, and Jim complained his book had sold exactly one copy.

cite.t: I'm actually really disappointed in how poorly my book is doing. I've only sold one copy.

trivia.q: In “Spooked”, which video game character is Dwight dressed as for Halloween?
trivia.why: Toby’s no-weapons rule stripped the costume of its bladed wings, so Kelly guessed “Jamaican zombie woman” and Ryan guessed Whoopi Goldberg.

cite.t: Damnit. I AM Kerrigan from Starcraft! I've been censored.

trivia.q: In “Doomsday”, what happens if the office makes five mistakes in one day under Dwight’s new system?
trivia.why: The emails would include an old consultants’ report recommending the branch be shut down, plus every negative email the staff had written about Robert.

cite.t: Or in this case an email gets sent to Robert California containing the consultants report from last year. Remember the one that recommended the branch be shutdown? And as a fail-safe also every negative email you've ever written about him to the group will also be forwarded to him.

trivia.q: In the “Pam’s Replacement” cold open, Andy asks Erin to interrupt his client meeting with a made-up phone call. What does she claim has happened?
trivia.why: Erin said his mom had been hit by a bus, then had Darryl call in on line 2 pretending to be a police officer.

cite.t: Really? Because your mother is dead.

trivia.q: In “Gettysburg”, what does the “Battle of Schrute Farms” turn out to have been?
trivia.why: The name was a code used by pacifists from both sides, who turned the Schrute farmhouse into an artistic community where they put on plays and sang ballads.

cite.t: But the Battle at Schrute Farms was no battle at all. It was a code used by pacifists from both North and South who turned the Pennsylvania farmhouse into an artistic community and a refuge from the war.

trivia.q: In “Mrs. California”, what side business does Dwight open inside the office building?
trivia.why: Dwight called it “Dwight Schrute’s Gym for Muscles,” but Darryl said it looked like a scene out of Saw 5 and told him to make a real gym.

cite.t: Well today's your lucky day. I have opened in this very office building Dwight Schrute's Gym for Muscles. You wanna take a look?

trivia.q: In “Christmas Wishes”, what does Andy’s new girlfriend Jessica do for a living?
trivia.why: She coaches at Bryn Mawr, and later at the party Erin tells Andy her Christmas wish is that Jessica was dead.

cite.t: Hey everyone! I want you to meet Jessica, she is an assistant cross country coach at Bryn Mawr.

trivia.q: In “Trivia”, which team wins the gay bar’s trivia night?
trivia.why: Kevin, Meredith, Erin and Kelly played as the Einsteins and beat Oscar’s team when Kevin named the film in the last question.

cite.t: The Einsteins win it!

trivia.q: In the “Pool Party” cold open, what food does Jim keep hiding in Dwight’s things?
trivia.why: The twist was that Dwight and Stanley were splitting the haul, and Dwight said “that idiot” Jim had been feeding them for a week.

cite.t: Thirty-two meatballs.

trivia.q: In “Jury Duty”, what was Jim really doing for most of his week of “jury duty”?
w: Selling to clients on the side
trivia.why: He was dismissed around noon on the first day, stayed home because Pam was overwhelmed with the kids, “and then three other days happened.”

cite.t: I did get called in to jury duty. And they released me around noon, so, didn't think it was worth it to come back to work for a half day. And then the next morning Pam was a little overwhelmed with the kids so I took an extra day to help out. And then three other days happened.

trivia.q: In “Special Project”, which city does the Scranton team head to for three weeks to launch the Sabre store?
trivia.why: The final team was Dwight, Jim, Stanley, Ryan, Erin and Cathy, and Erin quietly decided she was going to Florida and not coming back.

cite.t: No, this is legit. You will be assembling a team to go to Tallahassee for three weeks to develop and launch a chain of Sabre stores.

trivia.q: In “Tallahassee”, what sends Dwight into surgery on the first day of the Sabre project?
trivia.why: Dwight demanded that Jim be arrested for poisoning him, then came back after only about three hours at the hospital, with his appendix saved as a souvenir for Phillip.

cite.t: You need an operation. You have appendicitis.

trivia.q: In “After Hours”, what excuse does Cathy give for hanging out in Jim’s hotel room?
trivia.why: She said it was like 90 degrees in there. Jim later got Dwight to come to his room by claiming he’d seen a bedbug in the bed.

cite.t: Hey, uh, good. Uh, the heating system though in my room is all messed up. It's like 90 degrees in there. Maintenance is working on it. Can I hang out here?

trivia.q: In “Test the Store”, who actually gave Andy his black eye?
w: A mugger in the parking lot
trivia.why: Andy claimed he fought off a gang on motorcycles, but the girl’s mother brought her in to apologize, and she had also hit Pam with a pine cone.

cite.t: Yeah, no, it seems to be going great. Andy got beat up by a fifth grade girl?

trivia.q: In “Last Day in Florida”, who ends up fired as vice president of Sabre Retail?
trivia.why: Jim physically held Dwight back from the big presentation, so Packer stepped in as vice president and was fired after about half an hour in the job.

cite.t: And yet Todd, it's you who's fired.

trivia.q: In “Get the Girl”, who shows up and declares herself Scranton’s new manager while Andy is in Florida?
trivia.why: With Andy off chasing Erin, Nellie set up camp in his office and handed out surprise raises in her performance reviews.

cite.t: So no one can tell me what's going on. Well, let me illuminate things for you. We are getting to know each other. But why, m'lady? Because I am your new manager.

trivia.q: In the “Welcome Party” cold open, what can nobody agree on while signing Stanley’s get-well card?
trivia.why: Pam’s card made a joke about his moustache, and when Stanley walked in back from his tonsillectomy, he did have one.

cite.t: Okay, Phyllis sits across from him every day. Phyllis, does he have a moustache or not?

trivia.q: In the “Angry Andy” cold open, what does Jim promise everyone if Phyllis says all twelve of her rain clichés by noon?
trivia.why: Darryl and Pam had to coax out the last one, about staying home “curled up with a good book,” and it came just as Jim called noon.

cite.t: Phyllis says the same twelve clichés every time it rains. So, I promised everyone that if she says them all by noon today, I will send out for hot chocolates.

trivia.q: In the “Fundraiser” cold open, which singer’s reported death sends Ryan into mourning before it turns out to be a hoax?
trivia.why: Once the hoax was exposed, Jim found the singer was playing State College, and Ryan found reasons not to pay $250 a ticket.

cite.t: Smokey Robinson Pam. He died like an hour ago, I guess I'm the first to know.

trivia.q: In “Turf War”, who lands the biggest client left behind by the closed Binghamton branch?
trivia.why: The recently fired Andy walked in as a “rogue” paper salesman, promised the CEO his full attention, then offered Robert the account in exchange for his old job.

cite.t: You once put me on a list of the losers in the office. Well, this loser just got your biggest client to give him all their business. So hire me back, that business is yours. Don't, and I will find another buyer.

trivia.q: In “Free Family Portrait Studio”, who has Andy convinced to buy Dunder Mifflin back from Sabre?
trivia.why: Wallace had become a multi-millionaire by selling his toy vacuum, “Suck It,” to the U.S. military.

cite.t: Mmm, I can't hold it in any longer. Um, I am faking this, okay? Because I convinced David Wallace to buy Dunder Mifflin back from Sabre. And at three o'clock today he's gonna walk in here and reinstate me as manager.

trivia.q: In “Free Family Portrait Studio”, what is Dwight really after with his free portraits?
trivia.a: A sample of Angela’s baby’s DNA
w: Photos for a Schrute Farms ad
trivia.why: Dwight fussed over Phillip’s hair, fingernails and skin cells, then grabbed the dirty diaper to prove he was the father.

cite.t: I think that Dwight is doing this whole thing to, um, get a sample of my baby's DNA to prove he's the father. Which... is impossible... because the senator is the only man I've ever been with.

trivia.q: In “New Guys”, what nickname does Andy give Pete when he meets the new hires?
trivia.why: Andy said it was because Pete was always taking dumps, and he tried to call Clark “Fart” before going with the office’s “Dwight Jr.”

cite.t: In Outward Bound it was all about nicknames. They called me Iceman. You will be called Plop.

trivia.q: In “Roy’s Wedding”, what did Roy tell Laura he was doing while he secretly learned piano for her?
trivia.why: He played it at their 8 a.m. weekday wedding, a year to the day after meeting Laura, whom he took for a waitress until she said she owned the place.

cite.t: You know how I said I was taking boxing lessons? Actually, I was doing this. Um, so, I hope that you like it.

trivia.q: In “Andy’s Ancestry”, which famous person does Andy believe he is related to?
trivia.why: Nellie faked the family tree because she knew Andy would eat it up, and Oscar soon pointed out what the link implied about Andy’s ancestors.

cite.t: My fellow Americans, I have a feeling my approval rating is about to go through the roof. Turns out, I am related to Michelle Obama.

trivia.q: In “Work Bus”, what problem in the building forces the office out for a week and onto Dwight’s rented bus?
trivia.a: An electromagnetic field from bad wiring
w: A gas leak in the annex
trivia.why: Fixing it meant ripping open the walls, and Dwight’s contract as landlord required him to provide a temporary work space.

cite.t: It stands for electromagnetic field. Generally cause by a concentration of wiring in one area Especially if they're poorly insulated. Dwight.

trivia.q: In the “Here Comes Treble” cold open, what does Dwight get his head stuck in?
trivia.why: He greased his head and hollowed out the pumpkin for a joke on Erin, then claimed any blow to the pumpkin could prove fatal.

cite.t: My greased up head went into the pumpkin no problem, but ...

trivia.q: In “The Boat”, who does Andy take with him when he sails off on the family boat?
trivia.why: Andy found Walt Jr. on the boat in the middle of a relapse and pitched him three weeks of open ocean with no booze and “serious bro time.”

cite.t: Alright guys, cast us off. Walt, all aboard! Erin, this is because of you. Do you realize that? You're the best ever!

trivia.q: In “The Whale”, who turns out to be the buyer behind the huge Scranton White Pages account?
trivia.why: Jan had expected David Wallace to show up, and Dwight ended up offering her young Clark as her “personal Dunder Mifflin liaison.”

cite.t: Oh my God. It's Jan.

trivia.q: In “The Target”, who is the target of the man Angela hires through Dwight?
trivia.why: Angela had worked out that Oscar was sleeping with her husband, and Dwight’s friend Trevor planned a knee-capping with a lead pipe.

cite.t: You hired someone to hit me with a pipe!

trivia.q: In “Dwight Christmas”, which Christmas figure does Dwight dress up as for his Pennsylvania Dutch party?
trivia.why: As Belsnickel, Dwight judges people “impish” or “admirable”: Phyllis is admirable and gets rubber gaskets for canning jars, while Oscar and Jim are impish and get hit with his stick.

cite.t: What about an authentic Pennsylvania Dutch Christmas? Drink some gluhwein, enjoy some hasenpfeffer. Enjoy Christmas with saint Nicolas' rural German companion, Belsnickel.

trivia.q: In “Lice”, who really brought the lice into the office while Meredith takes the blame?
trivia.why: Pam had caught it from Cece and let the office blame Meredith, who shaved her head, until everyone heard Pam’s mom on the phone saying Cece still had lice.

cite.t: Maybe it was Meredith. Maybe she brought in lice that are totally different than the lice that i got from Cece. So let's not jump to the simplest conclusion that she got her lice from me. That is how wars get started. Fine, I'll tell her it was me.

trivia.q: In “Suit Warehouse”, what does Dwight ask Clark to pretend to be to land the sale?
trivia.why: The client ran a father-and-son suit store, and Dwight switched to a bad-relationship act once the owner admitted his own son hated his guts.

cite.t: How would you like to pretend to by my son in order to land a sale?

trivia.q: In “Customer Loyalty”, who steps in to comfort Pam after her phone fight with Jim?
trivia.why: When a cameraman calls his name, Brian tells him to give her a minute, then tells the crew to turn the cameras off.

cite.t: Nothing. You're doing the best you can.

trivia.q: In “Junior Salesman”, who ends up at Jim’s desk as the new junior sales associate?
trivia.why: Dwight stacked the interviews with buddies like Rolf, who goes fishing with hand grenades. When they flopped, he got Jim to turn them all down, and Jim picked Clark instead.

cite.t: Oh, cool. Hey Clark.

trivia.q: In “Vandalism”, what does Frank from the warehouse paint over Pam’s mural?
trivia.why: Pam struck back by painting Frank’s truck with a picture of him leaving a trail of poops, using water-based paint.

cite.t: I'm sorry I didn't like your crappy doodles. I drew a butt. Big deal. Butts are funny.

trivia.q: In “Couples Discount”, what does Erin end up doing after Andy comes home early from his boat trip?
trivia.why: She did it while David Wallace was still on the line with Andy, so Wallace heard that Andy had been gone for three months.

cite.t: We're breaking up. And just so you know, I was worried that you were dead. You were gone for three months.

trivia.q: In “Moving On”, who does Dwight recruit Angela to help him take care of?
trivia.why: Dwight said she needed “a woman’s touch,” and Angela refused to hose her down like an animal, insisting on a proper bath and a haircut instead.

cite.t: It's my aunt Shirley, she's on her last legs.

trivia.q: In “The Farm”, what does Dwight’s brother Jeb actually grow on his nine-acre farm?
trivia.why: Jeb bought what he thought was a worm farm from a Californian, and Dwight was disgusted he hadn’t grown something like a peanut-grape hybrid instead.

cite.t: I can't stand the fact that Jeb is a pot farmer. He could've grown anything. Anything in the world. He used to talk about growing a peanut-grape hybrid. One plant, one sandwhich.

trivia.q: In the “Promos” cold open, which audiobook has Phyllis getting a little too worked up at her desk?
trivia.why: Toby said she was allowed to feel aroused at work as long as she didn’t act on it, so Dwight stepped in himself and Andy confiscated it until the end of the day.

cite.t: She's listening to 50 Shades of Grey.

trivia.q: In “Stairmageddon”, how does Dwight get Stanley out to a sales call while the elevator is down?
trivia.a: Shoots him with a tranquilizer dart
trivia.why: The dose was meant for “a very small bull,” and a woozy Stanley still closed a sale with one of the branch’s biggest clients.

cite.t: Don't worry, it's just a bull tranquilizer. Nothing to be alarmed about. It's just a man pointing a bull tranquilizer at a coworker.

trivia.q: In “Paper Airplane”, who wins the office paper airplane contest and its $2,000 prize?
trivia.why: Dwight tried to tank the final so the newly broke Angela would get the money, but she told him not to dare, after Toby had crumpled his own plane to let her through the semi-final.

cite.t: And we have a winner. And it's Dwight. And it is everyone because this is over.

trivia.q: In “Livin’ the Dream”, why does Andy quit Dunder Mifflin?
trivia.why: David Wallace had come in planning to fire him over the boat trip and a head shot printer, but Andy cut him off and quit first.

cite.t: Well, no, actually. I see no reason to limit myself to just acting. I am pursuing fame of any kind. Could be singing, could be dancing. I don't--it just... I owe it to myself and my future fans.

trivia.q: In “A.A.R.M.”, what does Angela confess right after accepting Dwight’s roadside proposal?
trivia.why: She had lied because she needed Dwight to want to marry her for her own sake, and his answer was “Get out! I’m a dad!”

cite.t: Phillip's your son.

trivia.q: In “Finale”, who does Jim secretly bring in to stand beside Dwight at his wedding?
trivia.why: Jim called it the “best prank ever,” and Michael greeted Dwight with one last “That’s what she said.”

cite.t: Michael. I can't believe you came.

trivia.q: In “Finale”, what got Kevin fired by Dwight?
trivia.why: Dwight fired him with a cake frosted “Get out,” and Kevin later bought a bar.

cite.t: That's the reason Kevin got fired. It's his magic number. He used to use it to balance his accounts. He used to call it a Keleven. He told Dwight, "A mistake plus Keleven gets you home by seven." He was home by 4

trivia.q: In “Finale”, what did Creed do the day after the documentary aired?
trivia.a: Faked his death in the baler
w: Fled to Canada on a bus
Hid out on a fishing boat
trivia.why: The stunt only fooled Kevin, and the police went on to reveal Creed’s 1960s past in the band The Grass Roots.

cite.t: I brought in some new faces, and one old. I always like Devon. I hired him back after Creed faked his own death in the baler the day after the doc aired. The only person he fooled was Kevin. Then the police showed up. Turns out, Creed was in the band "The Grass Roots" in the 1960's. During that time, the police say he sold drugs and trafficked in endangered species meat and stole weapons-grade LSD from the military.
